title: A Pool Party
tagline: An OmniChain Single Sided Liquidity Provider designed for maximum capital efficiency and ease of use! Utilizing Uniswap v4 hooks & Hyperlane's cross-chain messaging service.
description: A 'Pool Party' is just as enjoyable as its name suggests. At its core, it allows your capital to interact seamlessly through our specially minted proxy token, which facilitates fast and efficient exchanges across various blockchains. We leverage the Uniswap V4 integration to ensure stable liquidity and equitable trades. Moreover, with the advanced cross-chain messaging technology from Hyperlane, your assets can securely traverse vast blockchain networks without any compromise.
how_its_made: My brother and I built the protocol by subdividing the labor with myself(Luke) being the frontend developer and Alex the smart contract designer. I used Wagmi cli and walletconnect v3 with the modal to easily generate my starting place and work much more efficently to build the website. Alex worked with Hyperlane for many hours to finally secure and operate his relay to scroll, but then he realized that Uniswap wasn't as Unified as he thought. With many of their deployments to testnets still missing, this wouldn't work out well for our protocol idea. So with help from Uniswap, he worked to squeeze Uniswap v4 onto gnosis and other chains so that our protocol may be able to demonstrate its multichain capabilities
